name: Buphedrone
summary: A cathinone stimulant first discovered in 1928, has gained some modest popularity as a mephedrone replacement. It is reported to be to be around 2-3x more potent than methcathinone.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Buphedrone is a substituted cathinone, and more broadly related, a substituted amphetamine and substituted phenethylamine and, as such, operates as a norepinephrine-dopamine releasing agent, similar to many of the drugs in its chemical class(es).

uses.text: Like many other synthetic cathinones (e.g. mephedrone), it is also found in so called "legal highs" (sometimes also called "bath salts"), a class of designer drugs used to bypass legal restrictions.
uses.routes: Vaporization, insufflation, Intravenous injection, intramuscular injection, orally, rectal, buccal
